# Electrical design

[Project overview](../README.md) · [Documentation](../docs/README.md) · [Local design review](http://localhost:8765/site/)

Native KiCad sources for the two-port AGX adapter and the four-port engineering variant.

## Open a project

| Variant | KiCad project | Intended scope |
|---|---|---|
| Two-port | [Open 2-port](2port/thor-2port.kicad_pro) | Documented FSI CAN0 and CAN1 |
| Four-port | [Open 4-port](4port/thor-4port.kicad_pro) | Adds reserved generic A02 channels; IGX support unverified |

[interface.json](interface.json) owns the connector mapping. [jlcpcb-profile.json](jlcpcb-profile.json) records the dated supplier capabilities and stricter project limits. [Thor.pretty](Thor.pretty/README.md) pins the actual footprint geometry used by both boards.

## Review before editing

Read the [NVIDIA pinout proof](../docs/pinout-proof.md), [protection rationale](../docs/interface-and-protection.md) and [native header audit](../research/j47-footprint-audit.md). All power, termination and shield shunts ship open. [Controls and prototyping](../docs/termination-and-io.md) identifies every link and the isolated pad fields. DE9 pin 9 has no power.

The committed layouts contain explicit paired CAN routing and return-plane keepouts. Regenerating the electronics can erase that routing; use the documented [tool sequence](../tools/README.md).
